fields.title: 📖 Muḥākamah: The Rabb and the Lawgiver are not to be separated
fields.body:
🖋️ **ash-Shanqīṭī** said:

> ***“ash-Shanqīṭī explained that it belongs to Allah’s right that He alone decides in legislation, and that no judgment is set equal to His judgment.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** Whoever acknowledges Allah as Lord may not give His right in the Ḥukm to a creature. Rubūbiyyah and legislation belong together.

immutable.source: 📝 ash-Shanqīṭī, Aḍwāʾ al-Bayān, Erklärung zu den Āyāt des Ḥukm und der Gesetzgebung.
